about_the_game:
Dive into a ruthless world overrun by mutants!
Ashes Remember Us is an intense active horde-based tower defense game with one ultimate goal: survive— for as long as you can!

Build powerful defenses, construct mighty towers, and customize your weapons to fit your playstyle. Every day brings hope, every night brings terror. When the sun sets, waves of mutants come flooding in, stronger and deadlier than ever before.

Features:

  • Customizable weapons are your advantage: Modifications enhance range, precision, and stopping power. Tactical upgrades let you adapt your arsenal to new enemies and escalating threats — flexible, efficient, and life-saving.

  • Towers: Build layered defenses with traps, barricades, and automated turrets. Smart timing and placement neutralize incoming waves and create controlled fallback options.

  • Dynamic day-night cycle with events: When night falls, the rules change. Enemies behave differently, new threats emerge, and surprise events keep you on edge. Darkness, aggression, and chaos turn every night into a brutal fight for survival — will your preparation be enough? 

  • Challenging boss fights: Every few waves, a powerful enemy appears — testing your tactics, exploiting weak points, and pushing your resource management. Use special weapons and the environment to bring them down.

  • Endless survival mode: With each wave, the mutants grow in numbers, speed, and lethality. Mistakes are fatal — only smart planning, precise gear, and constant adaptation will keep you alive. There’s no escape — just one question: how long can YOU survive?

Get ready— in Ashes Remember Us, there’s only one rule: Stay alive.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence and blood. Enemies and the player character can die in combat, leaving visible blood on the ground. Death animations are present for both enemies and the player.

There are no depictions of sexual acts or sexual themes.
There are no instances of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in the storyline or gameplay.
